title: Multimodal Conditioning of Fine-Tuned Stable Diffusion XL for Controllable and Culturally Faithful Ulos Motif Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.17987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The traditional Batak Ulos weaving industry faces growing challenges in producing diverse, innovative motifs due to limitations in conventional, manually driven design methods. This study proposes a multimodal generative framework integrating a fine-tuned Latent Diffusion Model (Stable Diffusion XL v1.0 via LoRA) with a Multimodal Large Language Model (LLaMA 1.5-7B) to enable controllable, culturally faithful Ulos motif generation. Four complementary conditioning mechanisms: text, image, representation, and semantic map (via ControlNet) jointly guide the generation process, each governing a distinct aspect from semantic intent to spatial layout. A five level ablation study across three scenarios (shape transformation, colour variation, and high-complexity input) shows that conditioning effectiveness is not proportional to the number of mechanisms combined: Text + Image + Semantic Map achieved the best FID (270) and CLIP Score (0.65 - 0.7

translated_title: 面向可控且文化忠实的乌洛斯纹样生成的微调Stable Diffusion XL多模态条件控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.17987v1 公告类型： new 摘要： 传统的巴塔克乌洛斯纺织工业正面临日益严峻的挑战，由于传统的人工驱动设计方法的局限性，难以产出多样化、创新的纹样。本研究提出了一种多模态生成框架，该框架集成了经微调的潜在扩散模型（通过LoRA微调的Stable Diffusion XL v1.0）与多模态大语言模型（LLaMA 1.5-7B），以实现可控且符合文化特征的乌洛斯纹样生成。四种互补的条件控制机制——文本、图像、表示和语义图（通过ControlNet实现）——共同引导生成过程，每种机制控制着从语义意图到空间布局等不同方面。一项涵盖三种场景（形状变换、颜色变化和高复杂度输入）的五级消融研究表明，条件控制的有效性与所组合机制的数量并不成正比：文本+图像+语义图的组合取得了最佳的FID（270）和CLIP分数（0.65-0.7
tldr: 该研究提出融合LoRA微调的Stable Diffusion XL与多模态大语言模型的多模态生成框架，通过文本、图像、表示和语义图四种条件机制实现可控且文化忠实的巴塔克乌洛斯纺织纹样生成，并发现三种条件组合（文本+图像+语义图）的效果最佳，条件机制并非越多越好。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a multimodal generative framework combining LoRA fine-tuned Stable Diffusion XL with a multimodal LLM, using four conditioning mechanisms (text, image, representation, and semantic map) to enable controllable and culturally faithful Ulos motif generation, finding that the Text + Image + Semantic Map combination achieves the best results rather than simply combining more mechanisms.
